components.name: Events primary link
components.description: Source-extracted intro action; no additional hover treatment is invented.

components.name: Events secondary button
components.description: Load more/retry button; disabled state dims and uses wait cursor.

components.name: Event category
components.description: Pressed state is represented by aria-pressed, not by a fabricated hover state.

components.name: Venue selection
components.description: Native select and visible label; preview includes only the local public-page styling, not inherited management focus effects.

components.name: Event card shell
components.description: Text-only preview of the card shell; campaign imagery is live event data, not bundled example art.

components.css: .ds-nav{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px}.ds-nav a,.ds-nav button{min-height:38px;padding:0 13px;border:0;border-radius:12px;background:transparent;color:#5d5b59;font:700 12px/38px -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI',sans-serif;text-decoration:none;white-space:nowrap}.ds-nav a.ds-active{background:#f4e8e7;color:#c9202d}.ds-nav button{border:1px solid #dedbd7;background:#fff;cursor:pointer}.ds-nav :is(a,button):focus-visible{outline:3px solid #d9212f;outline-offset:4px}@media(max-width:520px){.ds-nav a,.ds-nav button{padding:0 10px;font-size:11px}}
